terms.comment: Lewis & Short (s.v. ecce): “here I am”; the answer in hide-and-seek.

terms.gloss: I’m here, present; at your service
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 1031: Adsum, imperā, sī quid vīs.
terms.comment: The answer to one’s name, and to a call for help.

phrases.latin: Dīc ubi es? … ubi es? — Ecce mē. accēde ad mē atque adī contrā.
phrases.english: Say where you are? … where are you? — Here I am; come to me, come this way.
Here I am; give your orders, if you want anything.

sources: The phrase is composed; the grouped card gave no source.
Lewis & Short: ecce · Lewis & Short: adsum
